openOnLaunch.label: Open this budget on launch
openOnLaunch.description: Skip the picker and open this budget automatically when the app starts.

currency.title: Currency
currency.changeNotice: Changes display only — your balances aren’t converted.

switchWarning.title: Switch default currency?
switchWarning.description: This budget has accounts in other currencies. Switching re-expresses every stored exchange rate into {{currency}} — your history keeps its shape but values are restated in the new currency, and cents may shift slightly. For a clean start you’re usually better off creating a new budget in {{currency}}. Continue?

currency.noSymbol: {{currency}} has no symbol, so position has no effect.
currency.rateHistoryNote: Updating a rate only changes today’s balances — past transactions keep the rate from the day they happened.

chatInstructions.title: Chat instructions
chatInstructions.description: Help Capy understand your finances — common patterns, account purposes, categorization preferences. Applies to new conversations.
chatInstructions.placeholder:
e.g. I use my Chase card for daily expenses.
Whole Foods and Trader Joe's are groceries.
Venmo transfers to Sarah are rent splits.
